# Bile bomb

Internal ID: BombBile | Type: Bomb | Source: Workbench | Wielding: One-handed | Crafting Materials: Sap x1, Bilebag x1, Resin x3

# Introduction

Bile bomb is a thrown weapon that creates a Fire and Poison 4-meter radius AoE cloud, which stays for 10 seconds. Anyone in the cloud (excluding the thrower) takes 15 fire damage over 5 seconds, and 30 poison damage over 6 seconds. If an enemy stays in the cloud, the fire damage stacks (reapplying every second) and the poison duration is refreshed, so the maximum damage is 15*10 fire + 30*(10+6)/6 poison = 150 fire + 80 poison.
Damage value does not depend on any player skill, but may be altered by enemy resistance.

## Availability

• Crafted with the Workbench, stacks up to 50
• Sap can be extracted from Ancient Roots in the Mistlands biome using the Sap Extractor.
• Bilebags are dropped by Gjall in the Mistlands.
• Resin is dropped by Greydwarf, Greydwarf shaman and Greydwarf brute. It has a chance of dropping from chopped Birch trees and Smaller Beech Trees.
